Name: Custom Bouquets
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds a recipe to the crafting menu for bouquets. Clicking on the recipe doesn't craft the item, it brings you to a sub-menu with a list of potentially craftable bouquets based on the flowers currently in your inventory.

Bouquets are made up of three flowers; by default, the same colour flower can be used more than once in a bouquet. Each bouquet also requires one fiber to craft.

With the five types of vanilla coloured flowers, there are thousands of potential bouquets you can craft, limited only by the flowers in your inventory.

Modders can edit the bouquet and flower textures using the following Content Patcher paths:
[b]
"aedenthorn.CustomBouquets/bouquet"
"aedenthorn.CustomBouquets/flower1"
"aedenthorn.CustomBouquets/flower2"[/b][b]
"aedenthorn.CustomBouquets/flower3"[/b]

The flower textures are greyscale as they will receive tints from the flowers used in crafting.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
